# Vendor Info: Oswald (Fontsource)

- **Project**: [Headings font of the Markdown preview themes](https://github.com/googlefonts/OswaldFont)
- **Version**: 5.3.0
- **License**: OFL-1.1
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/@fontsource/oswald)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Click "Choose parent folder" and select the root directory (e.g. `vendor/`).
3. Select **Oswald (Fontsource)** from the dropdown menu.
4. Click "Download Target Version". The tool will automatically target the `vendor/fontsource-oswald/` subfolder, create it if needed, and write the updated files.
5. Update [sw.js](../../sw.js), [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md) with generated related snippets.

**Files maintained by the updater**
* `files/oswald-latin-500-normal.woff2`
* `files/oswald-latin-700-normal.woff2`
* `LICENSE`
